mapper.select: SELECT trip_id, trip_region_id, mission_min, mission_max, mission_start_at, end_date AS endDate FROM trip WHERE trip_id = #{tripId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_daily_goal( trip_id, day_no, target_round_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{dayNo}, #{targetRoundCount}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT mc.mission_candidate_id, m.mission_id, m.mission_type, m.title, m.description, m.difficulty, mc.selected_yn, mc.rerolled_yn FROM mission_candidate mc INNER JOIN mission m ON m.mission_id = mc.mission_id WHERE mc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND mc.day_no = #{dayNo} AND mc.assigned_order = #{assignedOrder} AND mc.rerolled_yn = 'N' ORDER BY mc.mission_candidate_id ASC

( #{tripId}, #{dayNo}, #{assignedOrder}, #{missionId}, #{pickerMemberId}, 'N', 'N', 1, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT mc.mission_candidate_id, m.mission_id, mc.picker_member_id, mc.day_no, mc.assigned_order, m.mission_type, m.title, m.description, m.difficulty FROM mission_candidate mc INNER JOIN mission m ON m.mission_id = mc.mission_id WHERE mc.trip_id = #{tripId} AND mc.mission_candidate_id = #{missionCandidateId} AND mc.selected_yn = 'N' AND mc.rerolled_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE mission_candidate SET selected_yn = 'Y' WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND mission_candidate_id = #{missionCandidateId} AND selected_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_mission( trip_id, mission_id, day_no, assigned_order, status, started_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{missionId}, #{dayNo}, #{assignedOrder}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_rel_trip WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND status = 'JOINED'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM setlog WHERE trip_mission_id = #{tripMissionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT tr.latitude, tr.longitude FROM trip t INNER JOIN trip_region tr ON tr.trip_region_id = t.trip_region_id WHERE t.trip_id = #{tripId}
SELECT m.mission_type FROM trip_mission tm INNER JOIN mission m ON m.mission_id = tm.mission_id WHERE tm.trip_mission_id = #{tripMissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO location_verification_log( trip_id, trip_mission_id, member_id, latitude, longitude, distance_meter, success_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{tripMissionId}, #{memberId}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{distanceMeter}, #{successYn}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_mission SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND trip_mission_id = #{tripMissionId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE trip_mission SET status = 'FAILED', failed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND trip_mission_id = #{tripMissionId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mission_daily_goal mdg WHERE mdg.trip_id = #{tripId} AND mdg.target_round_count > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_mission tm WHERE tm.trip_id = mdg.trip_id AND tm.day_no = mdg.day_no AND tm.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'NOT_PERFORMED') )

SELECT mdg.trip_id AS tripId, mdg.day_no AS dayNo, mdg.target_round_count AS targetRoundCount FROM mission_daily_goal mdg INNER JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = mdg.trip_id WHERE t.status = 'CREATED' AND DATE_ADD(t.mission_start_at, INTERVAL (mdg.day_no - 1) DAY) < CURDATE() AND mdg.target_round_count > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_mission tm WHERE tm.trip_id = mdg.trip_id AND tm.day_no = mdg.day_no AND tm.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'NOT_PERFORMED') )
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_mission SET status = 'FAILED', failed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND day_no = #{dayNo} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_mission( trip_id, mission_id, day_no, assigned_order, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{missionId}, #{dayNo}, #{assignedOrder}, 'NOT_PERFORMED', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE trip SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND status = 'CREATED'
mapper.select: SELECT mission_candidate_id, mission_id, picker_member_id, day_no, assigned_order, reroll_count FROM mission_candidate WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND mission_candidate_id = #{missionCandidateId} AND selected_yn = 'N' AND rerolled_yn = 'N' AND reroll_count > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE mission_candidate SET rerolled_yn = 'Y' WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND mission_candidate_id = #{missionCandidateId} AND selected_yn = 'N' AND rerolled_yn = 'N' AND reroll_count > 0
mapper.select:
